about_the_game:
PengPong is a survival roguelike that fuses bullet-hell shooting with pinball in a vintage cartoon universe.

You play as a penguin armed only with a hockey stick, deflecting every weapon scattered on the ground to fend off swarming enemies. In this cute yet dangerous vintage cartoon world, every swing of your stick could decide your survival.

Key Features:

  • Survive by deflecting: Hockey pucks, bottles, knives, fireworks… Anything on the ground becomes a weapon. Face monsters with your stick and throw weapons back to defeat them.

  • Luck or risk: Spend chips dropped by monsters on safe shop upgrades, or test your fortune at the roulette. Sometimes, secret deals let you trade health or soul for powerful items.

  • Challenging difficulties & new maps: Face tougher foes and complex patterns at higher difficulties. Unlock new maps and gimmicks that constantly push your limits.

  • Endless synergies: With 100+ items and synergies, each run offers unique builds. Even the same weapon changes dramatically depending on upgrades and hyper capacities.

Physics-based bouncing combat! Attack by deflection!

Combat in PengPong is more than auto-shooting. Instead of direct hits, the core strategy lies in reflecting objects. While you can strike monsters directly, the key is bouncing surrounding weapons with your hockey stick to hit enemies.

For example, deflecting a molotov spreads fire and burns part of the map. Bouncing a gun makes it fire while spinning through enemies. Choosing the right object at the right time is the key to survival.

Challenge diverse difficulties

Space-like casinos, speakeasy bars, carnivals full of traps and gimmicks… and each stage brings a new bizarre map and unique threats.

Stronger monsters, complex patterns, harsher conditions - how long can you survive?

Bet on your fate

At the end of each wave, choose: take safe rewards, or throw chips into the roulette for bigger gains. But it doesn’t end there; upgrade and manipulate the roulette to rig probabilities and tilt luck in your favor.

Disguise trickery as fortune, craft your ultimate build, and shake the odds of survival with every choice!

short_description: In a faded cartoon casino, retired hockey player Peng faces swarming monsters. Deflect everything with your stick, laughing at fortune or falling to risk. Gather chips for safety or bet it all on roulette—this bizarre survivor shooter tests your choices and survival instinct.
supported_languages: English, Korean, Japanese, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, French, German, Spanish - Spain, Russian, Spanish - Latin America, Portuguese - Brazil, Portuguese - Portugal
